title: Brazilian Chicken Brochette
description: A flavorful Brazilian-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken brochette, grilled to perfection. Serve with your favorite sides for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: 2. In a blender or food processor, combine marinade ingredients and blend until smooth.
3. Place chicken in a large bowl and pour marinade over it. Toss to coat.
4. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread chicken and vegetables onto pork skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
7. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
